User Story: As a user, I want to sign in with email and OTP so that I can access my relevant app experience.
Acceptance Criteria: Email entry is required; OTP step appears after Continue; Verify action signs user in and routes to persona home.

User Story: As an investor user, I want to land on Dashboard after login so that I can quickly view portfolio health.
Acceptance Criteria: Investor persona is routed to /dashboard immediately after successful sign-in.

User Story: As a prospect user, I want to land on Explore after login so that I can discover investment opportunities.
Acceptance Criteria: Prospect persona is routed to /explore immediately after successful sign-in.

User Story: As a prospect, I should be blocked from investor-only screens so that I only see allowed functionality.
Acceptance Criteria: Access to /dashboard, /portfolio, /property/:id, /documents redirects prospect to /explore.

User Story: As an investor, I want to see key portfolio KPIs in one view so that I understand my current position quickly.
Acceptance Criteria: Shows Total Portfolio Value (or Property Value for single holding), capital growth £/% for selected range, Invested, Equity, Loans, Gross Yield, and Net Cash Flow.

User Story: As an investor, I want portfolio highlights so that I can quickly identify top-performing assets.
Acceptance Criteria: Highlights section shows Best Performer, Highest Gross Yield (when available), Avg Gross Yield, and optional region blurb; each highlight deep-links to the related property where applicable.

User Story: As an investor, I want AI-generated portfolio insights so that I can understand risks, opportunities, and recommended next actions.
Acceptance Criteria: Insights cards are generated by an AI agent from portfolio context (e.g. concentration, regional yield gaps, yield vs target, growth vs cash flow, pipeline); each card shows tone/metric and can CTA to Explore when relevant.

User Story: As an investor, I want to navigate from dashboard to deeper pages so that I can continue analysis.
Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard provides paths to Portfolio, Property Detail, Explore, Calculator, and Documents; time-range control (1M/3M/1Y/All) updates chart and growth metrics.

User Story: As an investor, I want to see all my holdings with summary metrics so that I can compare properties quickly.
Acceptance Criteria: Header shows holdings count and total portfolio value; each card shows image, reference, status, name, location, Value, Rent, Gross Yield, and capital growth % when available; mortgaged cards show Monthly, Outstanding, progress, and Next due.

User Story: As an investor, I want to open a property from portfolio so that I can view complete property-level details.
Acceptance Criteria: Tapping a holding card opens /property/:id for the selected property.

User Story: As an investor, I want an advisor CTA on portfolio so that I can request help while reviewing holdings.
Acceptance Criteria: Portfolio footer exposes Speak with advisor / contact flow.

User Story: As an investor, I want a property hero and overview so that I can confirm the asset basics and valuation position.
Acceptance Criteria: Hero shows image, reference, status, name, location, beds/baths/sq ft. Overview shows current valuation, capital growth since purchase, Purchase Price, Current Value, Equity, and Outstanding Loan with LTV.

User Story: As an investor, I want a Mortgage Plan section on owned leveraged holdings so that I can track repayments and schedule.
Acceptance Criteria: Mortgage tab appears only when a plan exists; shows lender, type, rate, monthly, outstanding, term, original loan, progress, next payment, and schedule filterable by All/Paid/Due/Upcoming.

User Story: As an investor, I want Income & Costs details so that I can see rent versus operating expenses and net cash flow.
Acceptance Criteria: Tenanted holdings show monthly rent vs expected, Service Charge, Management Fee, Mortgage, Total Costs, Net Monthly and Annual. In Build holdings show expected-rent empty state.

User Story: As an investor, I want Performance metrics so that I can compare growth, yield, and occupancy for the property.
Acceptance Criteria: Performance section shows Capital Growth %, Gross Yield (or em dash when not applicable), and Occupancy %.

User Story: As an investor, I want Value Over Time and long-term Projection so that I can evaluate historical and forward-looking returns.
Acceptance Criteria: Value chart supports 1M/3M/1Y/All. Projection supports 5Y/10Y/15Y with capital growth, cumulative income, total return, year-by-year breakdown, and assumptions disclaimer.

User Story: As an investor, I want Tenancy details when a tenant exists so that I can track occupancy end dates.
Acceptance Criteria: Tenancy section appears only when tenant data exists and shows tenant name, end date, and occupancy.

User Story: As an investor, I want to search and filter my document library so that I can quickly find required files.
Acceptance Criteria: Category filters (All, Contracts, Rental, Tax, Mortgage, Legal, Others) and search by name narrow results; header shows file count and new count.

User Story: As an investor, I want to upload and access documents so that portfolio paperwork stays centralized.
Acceptance Criteria: Upload adds document to library; open/download is available per item; filtered empty state offers upload CTA.

User Story: As a user, I want to browse curated opportunities so that I can discover suitable investments.
Acceptance Criteria: Header shows curated and available counts; cards show status, reference, city, name, unit types, completion, From price, Gross Yield Est., and 5-Yr Forecast.

User Story: As a user, I want to filter opportunities by City, Budget, and Gross Yield so that results match my interest.
Acceptance Criteria: Filters update result count; chips and Reset restore defaults; empty filter state is shown when no matches.

User Story: As a user, I want to open an opportunity for full details so that I can evaluate before contacting advisor.
Acceptance Criteria: Selecting an opportunity opens /explore/:id with contextual data.

User Story: As a user, I want opportunity hero and at-a-glance metrics so that I can assess price, yield, and availability quickly.
Acceptance Criteria: Shows image, status, reference, name, developer, location, tagline, Starting price, 5Y forecast, Gross Yield Est., Completion/tenure, and Availability (units available/total).

User Story: As a user, I want Why This Opportunity and Key Facts so that I understand the investment narrative and essentials.
Acceptance Criteria: Highlights bullets and Key Facts (developer, location/postcode, completion, tenure/lease years) are displayed.

User Story: As a user, I want an illustrative Mortgage Plan on the opportunity so that I can estimate deposit, loan, and monthly cost.
Acceptance Criteria: Available opportunities show illustrative deposit/loan/monthly/rate with personalisation note; sold-out/closed opportunities show summary state instead of a fake live schedule.

User Story: As a user, I want opportunity Projection outputs so that I can review capital growth, income, and total return horizons.
Acceptance Criteria: Projection section supports 5Y/10Y/15Y with capital growth, cumulative income, total return, chart/year breakdown, and assumptions.

User Story: As a user, I want a clear Contact Sales action so that I can request advisor follow-up from this opportunity context.
Acceptance Criteria: Bottom nav is hidden; sticky Contact Sales opens advisor sheet with selected opportunity context; optional #contact deep-link opens sheet on load.

User Story: As a user, I want to enter deposit, risk appetite, and investment horizon so that the calculator can start affordability modelling.
Acceptance Criteria: Inputs: Deposit Amount (£), Risk Appetite (Low/Med/High → suggested LTV 55/65/75), Investment Horizon (5/10/15 years). Continue is disabled below minimum deposit (£1,000). Progress shows 5-step wizard.

User Story: As a user, I want to configure Mortgage vs Cash and LTV so that I can see my estimated property budget and monthly mortgage.
Acceptance Criteria: Inputs: Investment Type (Mortgage/Cash), LTV slider (50–80% when Mortgage), Mortgage Type (Interest-only/Repayment). Outputs: Estimated property budget, Deposit/Loan/LTV breakdown, and monthly mortgage estimate using nationality-aware illustrative rate.

User Story: As a user, I want matched opportunities against my budget so that I can shortlist realistic developments.
Acceptance Criteria: Shows matched cards with Matches budget / Stretch badges, From price, Gross Yield, 5Y Growth; city refine chips; empty-match guidance when none fit. Selecting a card advances to Returns.

User Story: As a user, I want to refine development, unit type, purchase price, and nationality so that returns use my chosen deal setup.
Acceptance Criteria: Refine inputs: Development, Unit Type, Purchase Price (editable), City (readonly). Investor Setup: Nationality (UK Resident / Non-UK → rates 5.25%/6.25%), Mortgage Type when mortgaged. Derived costs use yield-based rent, service charge ~0.5% value, management ~10% rent.

User Story: As a user, I want detailed return metrics and cash-required budget so that I understand income and upfront cost.
Acceptance Criteria: Outputs: Total Return (£ and % over horizon), Monthly/Annual Rental Income, Net Monthly Income, Gross Yield Y1, Initial Cash Required (deposit or full price + SDLT UK 3%/Non-UK 5% + legal £2,500), Projected Future Value, plus Quick Look narrative and CTA to full projection.

User Story: As a user, I want long-term projection charts and assumption details so that I can evaluate capital growth and cumulative income.
Acceptance Criteria: Inputs: Holding period tabs 5/10/15. Outputs: Total Return headline, Capital Growth, Cumulative net Rental Income, property-value and cumulative-income charts, year outlook. Assumptions accordion shows capital growth 4.5%/yr, rental growth 3%, mortgage rate (or N/A), management 10% of rent, service charge 0.5% of value, cost inflation 2.5%. Speak to Advisor CTA available.

User Story: As a user, I want a seeded Run Numbers calculator from a property or opportunity so that I can model one asset with editable assumptions.
Acceptance Criteria: Seeded from property or explore source. Editable inputs: Property Price, Monthly Rent, Capital Growth %, Rental Growth %, Holding Period (5/10/15/20), Management Fee, Service Charge, Mortgage (annual), Reset. Outputs: Total Return £/%, Net Annual Income, Gross Yield Y1, Capital Growth £/%, Projected Future Value, Cumulative Income, Avg Net Income/Yr, and CTA back to source projection.

User Story: As a user, I want to contact an advisor from key screens so that I can get assisted guidance anytime.
Acceptance Criteria: Contact entry points exist from Dashboard, Portfolio, Opportunity Detail, Calculator, and Profile.

User Story: As a user, I want channel choices (call/callback/email) so that I can choose my preferred communication method.
Acceptance Criteria: Contact sheet shows Schedule a call, Request callback, and Email; each path shows success confirmation; opportunity context included when opened from Explore detail.

User Story: As a user, I want persona-specific navigation so that I only see relevant sections.
Acceptance Criteria: Investor sees Overview, Portfolio, Explore, Calc, Docs; Prospect sees Explore, Calc.

User Story: As product/design QA, I want empty and partial states available so that zero-data scenarios are validated.
Acceptance Criteria: Empty/partial states are available for Overview, Portfolio, Documents, Explore, and Calculator and visually distinguish no-data conditions.
